whyUs.title: Why Us?
whyUs.intro: The business plan points to a premium, hands-on academy model with strong operational discipline.
items: Proprietary curriculum designed and owned by the school.
Hands-on STEM learning built around real projects and demos.
Delivered by technically strong instructors aligned with the academy's positioning.
Compact 3-day rhythm that reduces fatigue and makes planning easier for families.
Strict cohort system that protects continuity and prevents late joiner disruption.
Premium quality with a practical, parent-friendly structure.
